listing.name: Dynamic Skill DP
listing.summary: Dynamically changes DP limits in skills to be 60% of your battle size. For example, if you play with 200 battle size, the full effect of Crew Training will only activate at 120 DP or less. (Normally it's 240 DP.)
listing.aiSummary: Changes skill DP limits to be 60% of the current battle size.

description:
Download: https://github.com/GunGuyDude-Starsector/dynamicskilldp/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.zip

RESTART YOUR GAME AFTER CHANGING BATTLE SIZE!

Dynamically changes DP limits in skills to be 60% of your battle size.
For example, if you play with 200 battle size, the full effect of Crew Training will only activate at 120 DP or less. (Normally it's 240 DP.)

I made this for personal use (I like playing with 800 battle size sometimes, and would still like skills to matter) so this mod is serious amateur hour. Feedback appreciated, but I may or may not act upon it.

aiDescription: Adjusts the DP thresholds for skills so they scale with the game's battle size setting. For example, with a battle size of 200, the full effect of Crew Training activates at 120 DP instead of the standard 240 DP. A game restart is required after changing the battle size setting.
